2.2.1.expected: Bounded per-popup event bridge passed into the native popup worker
2.2.1.actual: persistent_popup_session(session_id) is created in the Details observer and passed to show_owned_popup_menu_with_persistence

2.2.2.expected: Pump requested-state events through ExplorerRoot on the foreground context while the popup future remains active
2.2.2.actual: Foreground spawn polls the receiver every 4ms and calls apply_details_column_popup_event; headful log shows SetDetailsColumnVisibility during the open popup

2.2.3.expected: Drain accepted events before terminal completion; reject disconnected/invalid/stale/closed-owner delivery
